liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (3 reviews): Favorite 77-era Not Fade Away leading into a superb closing; Garcia noodles into Supplication patterns, then returns to NFA verse before drummers switch [10][11][17]
- **Brown-eyed Women** (1 review): Favorite Brown-Eyed Woman; pick-up notes start solidly on the one, unlike trickling in [9]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Nicest Looks Like Rain with Donna and Bobby vocals; stunning second set [10]
- **High Time** (1 review): The second set features a very gentle and perfect High Time [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-05-26.sbd.wizard.32302.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 173 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1977-05-26.aud.wizard.32092.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 181 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1977-05-26.mtx.chappell.sb30a.97016.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 182 min; rated 4.78/5 by 9 [3]
- **gd77-05-26.sbd.sacks.3224.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 4.54/5 by 35 [4]. Said about its sound: Crispy board recording; considered a little gem despite other great May 77 shows; Crystal clear, no hiss sound board; quality matches the May 22, 1977 recording; Tight, crisp mix; vocals relaxed with Donna shining and Phil all over the place [13][14][16]
- **gd77-05-26.aud.vernon.18746.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 159 min; rated 4.11/5 by 8 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording preferred over board; vocals are more upfront and solid throughout [12]

## Around the show

- Mickey is really smashing the drums on this one as well [16]
- Show is solid but not as good as some others on this remarkable tour [8]
- Sweet Terrapin and strong Roe and BEW; no clinkers in the performance [12]
- Slightly less intense than the previous night's Mosque gig, but still a fine show [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-05-26.sbd.wizard.32302.shnf**: transferred by Owen Brothers; source: SBD>MSR>DAT>SS>CD>EAC>WAV>DC6>SHN [1]. Also: Patch source is AUD to MC to DAT to CDR; Jerry Moore did not record; Wizard edited and mastered; mild noise filter and high-end boost applied [1]
- **gd1977-05-26.aud.wizard.32092.shnf**: transferred by Owen Brothers; source: AUD>MC>DAT>CDR>EAC>WAV>DC6>WAV [2]. Also: Wizard patched four missing songs from SBD; removed loud claps and adjusted EQ [2]
- **gd1977-05-26.mtx.chappell.sb30a.97016.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [3]. Also: Matrix uses decent AUD; removed SBD splice from another 77 show for accuracy; AUD pitched up 12 to 30 cents; Waves L2 used for minor limiting [3]
- **gd77-05-26.sbd.sacks.3224.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: SBD from 7-inch reels at 7.5ips; AUD by Jerry Moore with Sony mics; Scott Clugston patched AUD fixes; transferred via Darrin to etree [4]
- **gd77-05-26.aud.vernon.18746.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by C. Regan: [Grateful Dead Baltimore Civic Center 1977 Concert Flyer](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/1664328/Grateful-Dead-Baltimore-Civic-Center-1977-Concert-Flyer) [21]
- Fan art by C. Regan: [Grateful Dead Baltimore Civic Center 1977 Concert Flyer](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/632653/Grateful-Dead-Baltimore-Civic-Center-1977-Concert-Flyer) [22]
